reference.scope: Original column/overlay renderer at unit horizontal and vertical scale, using official Freedoom patches and COLORMAP; hardware/display, wall geometry and actor sorting are outside this witness.

scope: All 88 renderable weapon/flash state records with five clipped or fractional positions and horizontal reflection, using official Freedoom Phase2 patches.
Dark/bright sectors, extra light, fixed maps, full-bright frames and invisibility duration/blink boundaries, including fuzz-phase wrapping.
Two active weapon/flash layers preserve original draw order; both inactive layers leave the background alone.
The original six overlay/column functions run unchanged in the host-C witness, using native patch posts, COLORMAP, a patterned framebuffer and the original fuzz sequence.
Native and HEMU match every expected 32-bit framebuffer hash and final fuzz position; player records, pixel guards and world depth remain unchanged.

levelCarry.scope: Fuzz phase survives successful level replacement, alongside existing inventory/RNG/brain/session-clock contracts.

preview.scope: Inspected live game-state frame with the raised pistol. One cold draw is not a steady-frame-rate measurement.

limitations: The unused zero-tic S_LIGHTDONE callback state never reaches rendering and has no corresponding WAD frame; the fixture tests renderable states 2 through 89 and the inactive state separately.
Renderer comparisons use the fixed 320x168 unit-scale view and official Freedoom 0.13.0. They do not qualify arbitrary modified patches, resolutions or original full-scene Doom pixels.
World power-up lighting, spectre fuzz, HUD, sound output, interactive window lifecycle, progression/intermission and saves remain unfinished.
